relevance_note: Case report of a father and daughter with Danon disease: "both cases have Danon disease due to LAMP2 gene microdeletion".
method_note: Read the full Markdown by hand; a short Python script in the scratch directory assembled the JSON from hand-chosen values and spans and checked every span verbatim. No tables in the paper; no supplementary text in the file (supplementary tables S1-S7 are database variant lists and are not included). Scope: Case 1 (father), Case 2 (daughter) and Case 1's sister (tested negative by CMA). Not given rows (neither tested for the deletion nor affected): Case 1's healthy mother (refused testing), his healthy spouse (karyotype only; called healthy), and the couple's healthy 7- and 5-year-old sons. is_proband left null for both cases: the paper uses no proband/index wording and is not a single-patient report. Contradictions/notes: (1) Case 2's LAMP2 deletion is given two different descriptions: by CMA as the same deletion as Case 1 (Xq24(119513013_119623579)x0, 110.5 kb, GRCh37) and by WES as 'a heterozygous deletion of 98.456 Kbp length in chromosome X (chrX:119504569—119603024(GRCh37/hg19) that included ATP1B4 and LAMP2 genes'; the CMA string is recorded, WES coordinates only here. (2) The abstract says Case 1 was diagnosed at 13 with 'very mild and mostly asymptomatic cardiomyopathy and left ventricular hypertrophy', while the Results say his first echocardiography showed 'no signs of cardiomyopathy'; both feature rows emitted (LVH checklist item is supported independently by the echo at age 39). (3) Case 1's retinal phenotype is called 'retinitis pigmentosa' and 'rods and cones dystrophy' (abstract: 'cone–rod dystrophy'); both rows observed. (4) Palpitations observed at age 13 and denied on recent evaluation (time-separated; both rows emitted). (5) Case 2: normal cardiac echo at 18 months (Discussion) vs hypertrophy at 3 years (time-separated). Checklist choices: Case 1 ventricular tachycardia left not reported because the Holter finding is 'VT or SVT with an aberrant conduction'; Case 1 mood/anxiety and ADHD left not reported despite 'no psychiatric ... complaints' (broader complaint statement, not a disorder assessment); Case 2 SVT/VT left not reported despite 'arrhythmia was not documented' because Holter showed sparse atrial and ventricular ectopy; Case 1 proximal muscle weakness left not reported ('normal physical activity' and military service do not address weakness). Case 2 age at diagnosis taken as 14 months, when CMA identified the deletion. 'Basic metabolic evaluation ... was normal' recorded as written (excludes only that evaluation). TSC1 VUS and CPSF1 VOUS incidental variant rows are Case 2's (solo WES of Case 2). LAMP2 c.928G>A in the Discussion refers to unlabelled literature patients without individual-level facts and gets no row.
